answers.core:
Supporting shortcuts is more difficult than I had originally realized when I set out to solve this problem for myself.

I spent 2 hours trying to figure out how to provide an EditorScript tool (or plugin) the ability to handle input to check for a shortcut being entered.
By contrast In 30 minutes I implemented the feature into the engine, including the time it took to figure out all the places code would have to be altered/added.
(This might just be an example of how writing these types of scripts could use better documentation)

There is a reasonable assumption that toggling the vertical view planes is a significant workflow improvement, and adding the 'View Menu' entry for them improves discoverability which must be implemented in the engine to support.
answers.workaround: It could be possible to create a tool, EditorScript, or EditorPlugin which acts as a 'custom shortcut registry', however this does not address the options being added to the 'View Menu', which aids in discoverability.

title: Add "Grid Xy/Yz Plane" toggles to the 3D preview
